title: NetGraph
description: Clean, configurable HUD graphs of your connection quality - ping, jitter and bandwidth on any server, plus real TPS, MSPT and server load with the optional server companion
body:
# NetGraph A network monitor for the corner of your screen. It turns ping, bandwidth and the server's tick rate into small, readable graphs, so you can tell at a glance whether the lag is on your end or the server's. Runs on the client and works on **any** server. Add the optional companion and the graphs gain real server-side numbers.

## 📡 Measured on the client — any server Ping, jitter, download/upload (KB/s), packets per second, FPS, and a TPS estimate. No server mod required. ## 🖥️ Added by the server companion Real server TPS and MSPT, loaded chunks, entity count, players online, and the server's own ping reading. When the server stops answering — a freeze or a lag spike — the affected graph turns red and reads **TIMEOUT** instead of vanishing.

## ⚙️ Fits your HUD, not the other way around - 13 metrics, each toggled on or off on its own - Show any metric as text, a graph, or both - Six anchor points, plus margins, scale, width, graph height, opacity and history - Quality colouring from green to red - A settings screen that previews the HUD live while you drag the sliders, with a frame that flashes the real position when you move it - Reset to defaults in one click ## ⌨️ Controls **N** shows or hides the HUD (rebindable). Open settings from Mod Menu, or bind a key. ## 🛡️ Server command Operators can switch fields off: `/netgraph ` — and `/netgraph status` to check the current state. ## 📦 Install **Client** — put NetGraph in `mods`. Requires **Cloth Config API**; **Mod Menu** recommended. **Server (optional)** — put NetGraph Server in the server's `mods` for real TPS/MSPT. Singleplayer? Add it to your own `mods` folder too.
